messages:
Alex R: Heads up — after today's rollout (commit 9f3b2a7) CI perf tests flagged a latency regression on small-batch chat workloads (~+15% p99). perf-bot posted details.
perf-bot: PERF-CI: Regression detected on job runtime/e2e-small-batch — p99 latency increased 15.4% vs baseline. Trace ID: pb-8123
Priya S: saw the alert, rolling back canary now?
Alex R: yes, canary halted. Reverting PR #4821 in staging to confirm.
Marco T: I'm running a bisect on master — looks like merge 9f3b2a7 (kernel-selector refactor) correlates.
Jia L: kernel-selector? did we change heuristics for GPU kernel dispatch? That patch also touched kv cache invalidation logic.
Sam B: I pulled a perf profile from the failing job: attaching short flamegraph snippet.
Sam B: ```
# hot paths
kernel_selector::choose_kernel_for_block
serving::batcher::dispatch
kv_cache::fetch_or_build
```
Priya S: interesting — choose_kernel_for_block now prefers matmul-tiling kernel at seq=64 which increases kernel launch overhead for short sequences.
Alex R: also noticed kv_cache miss rate jumped from 3% -> 12% on the job. Could be batching changes reducing prefix reuse.
Marco T: I'll try reverting the kernel-selection heuristic locally and run microbenchmarks.
perf-bot: CI job runtime/micro-bench/seq64 failed threshold: p99 latency 24ms -> 29ms (+21%). Baseline ref: 1749990000
Jia L: if kernel choice is wrong for small sequences, we should add a size-aware fastpath rather than global preference.
Sam B: I bisected to commit 9f3b2a7 -> culprit is commit 9f3b2a7^/kernel-refactor - change in kernel_selector.cpp (choose_preferred_kernel).
Sam B: Proposed revert PR #4830 opened, will link.
Alex R: thanks. Reverting now in staging and promoting baseline. Also starting a postmortem thread later.
Priya S: For short term: revert, then add perf unit test covering seq=16/32/64 with batch sizes 1-8.
Marco T: For long term: add deterministic kernel-selection unit tests + thresholds, and add KV hit-rate regression alert for CI (per-query basis).
Jia L: Logged an issue: PERF-231 add seq/batch parameterized benchmarks and lock threshold to 10% p99.
perf-bot: Note: a few perf tests were flaky due to background noise — marking them flaky until baseline stabilizes.
Alex R: action items: 1) revert PR (Sam) 2) add microbench PR (Marco) 3) KV cache telemetry fix (Jia) 4) CI threshold tuning + non-flaky test work (Priya)
Sam B: Revert merged on master at 1750001450. Monitoring canary.
deploy-bot: canary deployment halted -> healthchecks passing on revert build.
perf-bot: Canary results: p99 back to baseline within 2%. Rolling forward.
Priya S: Retro scheduled tomorrow 10am. We'll tighten perf gates: require <8% p99 variance for canary and hard fail for >15%.
Alex R: Also adding a nightly benchmark that exercises kernel-selector across seq distributions to catch regressions earlier.
Jia L: I'll add KV-cache unit tests to ensure hit-rate doesn't regress by more than 5%.
Marco T: note: we should also instrument kernel selection reasoning in logs for one release to debug future surprises.
Alex R: perfect. Thanks all :thumbsup:
